articles.summary: As the 2026 hurricane season begins today, Duke Energy Florida is reinforcing its commitment to reliability and storm response following continued investments in grid hardening efforts.
articles.title: Duke Energy Florida is ready for 2026 hurricane season following continued grid hardening investments

articles.summary: As the latest effort to save customers money while meeting rising demand, DOE funding would support needed refurbishment at North Carolina and Kentucky power plants to strengthen reliability.
articles.title: The DOE announces grants for Duke Energy projects, bringing total funding to nearly $96 million

articles.summary: High temperatures are forecast across the Carolinas this weekend and next week, and Duke Energy has tips to help you take control of your energy use while keeping you and your family cool.
articles.title: Duke Energy offers tips to save energy and money as temperatures rise in the Carolinas

articles.summary: The Duke Energy Foundation is awarding nearly $830,000 in 54 grants to nonprofit organizations, cultural institutions and community partners in North Carolina, South Carolina, Florida, Indiana, Ohio and Kentucky.
articles.title: Duke Energy Foundation completes America250 grantmaking with 54 grants expanding access to local history and civic learning

articles.summary: Piedmont Natural Gas today announced it has decreased rates for its North Carolina customers. Combined, Piedmont’s 2026 rate decreases are reducing average residential customers’ bills by approximately 8%, or about $100, per year.
articles.title: Piedmont Natural Gas lowers rates, saving North Carolina residential customers $100 per year

articles.summary: As part of the final round of grants through the Duke Energy Foundation’s America250 initiative, $77,500 is being distributed to seven nonprofit organizations across Florida that are working to expand access to civic learning and remembrance.
articles.title: Duke Energy Foundation grants $77,500 to expand access to civic learning and remembrance across Florida

articles.summary: USA Rare Earth’s announcement of a major investment and new jobs in Cherokee County highlights the impact of Duke Energy’s Site Readiness Program, which helped prepare the Bailey Industrial Site for major economic development.
articles.title: Duke Energy site readiness efforts help land $1.2 billion advanced manufacturing project in Cherokee County

articles.summary: With summer officially underway, Duke Energy and the City of Pinellas Park are launching a joint awareness campaign encouraging local residents to complete a free Home Energy Check and get personalized recommendations to help them save energy – and money.
articles.title: Duke Energy, City of Pinellas Park team up to help local residents save energy and money this summer

articles.summary: The Duke Energy Foundation is offering $500,000 in grants to support nonprofit-led programs that help small businesses like restaurants and retail stores complete renovations, buy equipment or technology, purchase inventory or meet other business needs.
articles.title: Duke Energy offers $500,000 to support small businesses across North Carolina

articles.summary: As America’s 250th anniversary approaches this Fourth of July, Duke Energy Foundation is providing more than $260,000 in grants to South Carolina organizations to help preserve local history and expand civic learning across the Palmetto State. This is the final round of the Foundation’s America250 initiative, completing a $550,000 investment in South Carolina tied to the nation’s anniversary focused on community-driven projects.
articles.title: Duke Energy Foundation completes more than $550,000 in grants to South Carolina organizations celebrating nation’s 250th birthday

articles.summary: As the nation approaches Independence Day, Duke Energy is investing in American suppliers to help power local economies, support customer value and build the energy infrastructure needed to serve growing communities.
articles.title: Duke Energy’s nearly $1 billion investment with North Carolina suppliers strengthens American supply chains, local economies and the nation’s energy future

articles.summary: This weekend, Duke Energy Florida joined Citrus County and Coastal Conservation Association (CCA) Florida to release 100 redfish at the Pirates Cove Park in Crystal River.
articles.title: Duke Energy Florida’s redfish released into Crystal River waters alongside Citrus County, CCA Florida; anglers encouraged to catch them for cash prizes

articles.summary: Duke Energy has joined a new coalition of industry, education, government and NPO partners through the Siemens Foundation’s Careers Electric initiative to help close the electrician shortage gap.
articles.title: Duke Energy joins national Careers Electric™ coalition to build next-generation energy workforce

articles.summary: Duke Energy's new AI-powered Bill Insights helps Carolinas customers understand what’s driving their summer energy costs
articles.title: New this summer: An easier way to understand your energy bill

articles.summary: As the country approaches its 250th birthday, the Duke Energy Foundation is distributing $186,100 to 16 nonprofit organizations across North Carolina that are working to expand access to civic learning and remembrance.
articles.title: Duke Energy expands access to local history and civic learning across North Carolina through America250 grants

articles.summary: While summer heat has already settled across Florida, the astronomical start of the season is observed this Sunday, June 21. Duke Energy Florida is helping customers manage their energy use – and their bills – by offering practical tips focused on the five appliances that use the most energy in the home: air conditioners, water heaters, refrigerators, washing machines and dishwashers.
articles.title: Summer starts June 21: Duke Energy Florida highlights five key appliances to help customers manage energy use

articles.summary: The Duke Energy Foundation is awarding $500,000 through the 2026 Helping Emergency Response Organizations (HERO) Grant Program to help South Carolina communities be prepared for the impacts from severe weather. More than 30 organizations are receiving grants that will fund training, life-saving equipment and innovative technology identified as needs following severe weather events – all aimed to aid in weather-related disaster planning and recovery efforts.
articles.title: Duke Energy supports South Carolina first responders with $500,000 in grants for emergency preparedness
